title: Garmin Forerunner 255 Smart Watch Gray US$177.10 (~A$253.40) AU Stock Delivered @ Aussie Electron Store AliExpress
body:
Deal: Garmin Forerunner 255 Smart Watch Gray US$177.10 (~A$253.40) AU Stock Delivered @ Aussie Electron Store AliExpress

[Clear] This is one way to find out that a lot of products in Australia have massive margins.
[HaydosK] Yes stuff has large margins but how are they getting supply that cheap? Are they a licensed distributor?
[Clear] Garmin China is cheaper to both the consumer and the wholesaler in comparison to Garmin Australia. That's how we also get dirt cheap AMD CPUs from AliExpress, CN/HK stock is cheaper and OEM tray. Same applies to the Lenovo Xiaoxin tablets vs the local Lenovo Idea Tab range.
[HaydosK] @Clear: Yeah true. I didn't know that Garmin would be the same. I wonder if there is a list of products like this.
[OzSikh] Can this be used to get $$ off — https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/969659
[Clear] No point since it ends up being AU$254.69 (≈ US $176.22)
[knobbs] Isn't that the point? It's over 160 USD so you can use the PayPal promo to get a further discount?
[Clear] PayPal US$177.10 (~A$253.40) vs PayPal BNPL AU$254.69 (≈ US $176.22). Save the BNPL discount for something else.
[knobbs] @Clear: I misunderstand the PayPal deal then. Thought it was extra $ off on-top of whatever the checkout price was if via PayPal. Thought you could double stack it with anything
[Clear] @knobbs: Looks like that PayPal discount has hit max redemptions so it's not even applying. That's why it's 1% different.
[knobbs] I didn't know you could get legit Garmin watches from AliExpress. Can you get the full range or just select models for some specific reason?
[Clear] I've posted the Garmin Forerunner 265 a few times without issue. There's plenty of models around, though AU stock seems to be mostly 165, 255 and 265.
[knobbs] Ah bummer I usually get the Fenix range. I hate running haha
[FrozenFred] me and u brother, me and you. it also never gets easier, we just get faster :'(
[pyramid] @Clear we need now some deals on shaver from aliexpress….
[Lizard Spock] shaver
That's pretty specific of you. Also, clear is not a rep for AliExpress.
[hiya] Can this model from china do Garmin Pay in australia?
[JoeBogan] There’s a 20 percent cashback on TopCashback, if assuming it would apply?
[Clear] Yep. TopCashback UK uncapped is another option if you have it.
[twjr] Not just Perth. Doesn't look like anywhere in WA sadly.
[Wonderfool] I'm more of an instinct person. Anyone with a forerunner have experience with the running features?
[asspray] they took the paypal in 4 out but no showing it's processed?
[shrugies] For anyone on the fence, the 265 (AMOLED screen, newer etc) goes on a similar Ali sale for low-mid $300. Worth the upgrade imo since it’s nicer to use and look at, and will feel modern for longer (buy once cry once)
[Hugh G Rection] nah, save the 50 bucks if you are actually using this to run with.
If you want something nicer to use and look at, just get an Apple Watch.
Use the $50 saved and put it into a new pair of running shoes.
[shrugies] 100% agree you don’t NEED this to track runs and get use out of it. You could extend that argument and say even the 55 does most of what an average person would really need.
Saving $50-100 over the life of this thing (years and years) and number of runs, wearing it 24/7 except to charge- I think most people would prefer to spend the little extra
Disagree on the Apple Watch recommendation though- definitely a much better smart watch with smart watch features, but need to charge daily, substantially more expensive (not the $50-100 difference) and less capable of a fitness tracker (still does what most people need though)
[JustValerie] Agreed - totally opting for 265 against 255. Massively superior for relatively small $ difference
[sloppy sock] do you know when the 265 deal will come back?
[JustValerie] There's FR265 Black for aud $426 there. Still better than the local stock
